funds.title: Funds and spending
funds.intro: Shows recorded payments, scheme rollups and vouchers. Funds received and official balances are separate — when missing they are labelled unavailable, not zero.
funds.noMonthly: Vouchers share a single date or are too few for a monthly trend.
funds.plannedNote: Approved plan amounts and recorded payments are different concepts — do not add them as one expenditure total.

about.title: How to read the data
about.where: Where does the data come from?
about.whereBody: Primary sources are public eGramSwaraj reports — vouchers, physical progress, and the approved action plan.
about.howOftenBody: When an administrator downloads new reports and runs the import script. Villagers do not need to run anything.
about.metricsBody: “Recorded spending” = payment vouchers. “Approved cost” = administrative approval on physical progress. “Funds received” and “balance” come from other sources — when missing they are not shown as zero.
about.missingBody: Receipts, balances, audit, and asset data have not been imported yet. Gaps are not evidence of wrongdoing or of a clean record.
about.reportError: How to report an incorrect entry?
about.reportErrorBody: Compare with the original report. If figures differ, ask the Gram Panchayat / block office or use RTI for an official clarification.
about.notOfficial: This portal is not an official government website.
